rationale: The prompt requests a single, well-defined selection (channel with Robert as member whose topic concerns engineering team) followed by a state-changing invite of Nick. The route (CONVERSATION→CONVERSATION_MEMBERSHIP→USER) matches the joint-fact binding needed to disambiguate Robert Walsh (member of C03IJKL9012, C01ABCD1234, C02EFGH5678) from the same-named Robert Chen (member of unrelated-topic channels C_INFRA, C_MODEL, C_GROWTH, C_FRONTEND, C06ALPHADEV). Cross-checking base_seed confirms uniqueness: only C03IJKL9012 has topic 'Engineering Team' and a Robert (Walsh) member; other Robert-Walsh channels (general, random) have off-topic content, and other engineering-adjacent channels (project-alpha-dev) contain Robert Chen, not Walsh. Nick (U08NICK23) is confirmed not already a member of the target channel, making the invite consequential rather than a no-op. Written/change attributes (channel_members.channel_id/user_id) and answer_attributes (users.user_id/display_name) are legitimate bare columns matching schema and API (conversations.invite, users.list). Task spec, obligations, and access plan align with the prompt without introducing hidden requirements or unsupported capabilities. No mechanical errors were flagged and none found on review.
